description: Six builder stories: DeepSeek's V4.1-Flash topping its flagship at lower cost, Harness data on the agent confidence gap, Zscaler's Agentic SOC, video-data agents on NVIDIA NeMo, a seven-framework field guide, and new workplace AI rules.
lead: Small efficient models kept beating bigger ones, agent operations got a reality check, and security teams got agentic help. DeepSeek's new Flash model claims to outperform its flagship Pro at a fraction of the cost, Harness surveyed 700 leaders on why agent confidence outruns controls, and Zscaler launched an agentic SOC. Plus video-training-data agents, a practical framework roundup, and workplace AI rules builders should know. Every summary is in our own words; follow the links for the original reporting.
title: AI news digest — September 11, 2026: efficient models, agent governance, agentic security
